content: Kakuwu Weteri kemɨretɨa
Merikɨtsɨ Kakaɨyari Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Kenemie, Weteri kenekani. Mana mawari taiyame kenetawewi nehetsiemieme hakewa pemɨnetsihexei mana pe'uyemietɨ 'Etsahu hekɨ pe'uyu'unarɨmetɨ».
Hikɨ Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katiniwarutaxatɨani yutɨɨriyama meta hamatɨana memu'uwakai: «Xekeniwaruhayewa hipame wakakaɨyarixi yuhetsɨa xemɨwarexeiya, xekeneuyu'iti, hipame pɨta yu'ixurikite xeketenanakatɨxɨa.
Weteri paitɨ tekaniyehuni. Mana tenari mawari taiyame nekanetawewimɨkɨ Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme mɨnetsi'uparewi ne'uweiyariekaku, huyeta nehamatɨa mumie».
Hikɨ Kakuwu mekateniyetuirieni yukakaɨyarixi memɨwarexeiyakai, yunakɨtsate yunakatesie memanuyewutɨakai, Kakuwu katiniukateuku xiu hetɨa Tsikeni hehurakaku muwekai.
Kepauka memekɨ, nixewitɨ pɨkawaranukuwei Kakuwu tɨɨriyamama, waɨkawa memutimamakaikɨ kiekari mamanetɨkatsie.
Mɨpaɨ tiɨyɨku Kakuwu 'Arimetɨra maku'u kaninuani, tatsɨari Weteri, meta memeweiyakai yunaitɨ, Kanani kwieyaritsie.
Mana mawari taiyame kaniutawewieni, meta Weteri katiniuterɨwa, mana matsiɨkɨme mayuyeitɨakɨ Kakaɨyari kepauka 'Etsahu hekɨ muyu'unarɨmekai.
Hikɨ 'ana Rewura kaniumɨni, Xeweka mɨ'ɨwiyakai, xiu manuwe hetɨa mekanikateuku Weteri 'aurie. 'Ayumieme Kakuwu mana 'Eruni-Wakuti katiniuterɨwa.
Kepauka Kakuwu Parani-'Arami heyeyaka munua, hutarieka Kakaɨyari matsiɨkɨme kanayuyeitɨani 'aixɨa kaniyurieni,
mɨpaɨ tikɨhɨawetɨ: «Kakuwu pepɨtitewa, hikɨri mɨpaɨ pepɨkatitewaka. 'Ena mɨtiyehane 'Ixaheri pepɨtitewaka pɨta». Mɨpaɨ katiniterɨwa.
Tawarita Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Ne Kakaɨyari Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye nekanihɨkɨtɨni. Kenexiɨka kene'amɨiriyani. 'Ahetsie mepɨyekɨne yumɨiretɨ 'anuiwarima xeikɨa, manata te'aitamete mepɨtixuawere.
'Apɨrahami meta 'Itsahaki kwie nemɨwarumi 'ekɨ nepɨmatsiyetuirie meta 'anuiwarima».
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari Kakuwu hamatɨa tiutaxataka kaneyani.
Kakuwu mana tete kaniutakeni hakewa Kakaɨyari hamatɨa mɨretixa. Mɨkɨ tete kaxie winuyarikɨ kanika'ɨya meta huriwa hatseitiyari kanikawirieni,
hakewa Kakaɨyari Kakuwu metahɨawixɨ Weteri katiniuterɨwa.
Xakeri meta 'Itsahaki kememɨte'ukumawerixɨ
Hikɨ 'arike Weteri mekaniyekɨne. 'Epɨrata 'akuxi 'ahetewakaku Xakeri kaniutiniweni, waɨriyarika nunutsi kanayexeiya.
Kwiyɨanekaku niwenetɨ, tiniweritsitɨwame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Pepɨkamaka, tawarita xeime nunutsi 'uki pekanayexeiyarɨmeni».
Perutsɨ mɨkɨ mɨximetɨ, 'imatɨrieka yuniwe Wenuní katiniuterɨwa, peru paapaya Wenikamini pɨta katiniterɨwa.
Mɨpaɨ Xakeri katiniumɨni, 'Epɨrata huyeyari 'utɨa mekanikateuku, hikɨ Wereni mɨrakutewatsie.
Memekateukixɨtsie Kakuwu 'inɨari kaniutakeni, hikɨ 'akuxi peyuhekɨa hakewa Xakeri mekateukie.
'Ixaheri yuhuyeta kaneyani hikɨ Mirari-'Eraxi manunieretsie kaniutayerɨni.
Mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie mekutetɨ, Xuweni Wiriha hamatɨa kaniukahuni, yupaapa 'ɨyaya hamatɨa. Kepauka 'Ixaheri mɨretima waɨkawa kaniuyeha'ani.
Kakuwu tamamata heimana yuhutame kaniwarutinuarieni:
Reya niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: Xuweni, Kakuwu matɨarieya matɨa, Tsimehuni, Rewi, Kura, 'Itsakaxi meta Tsawuruni.
Xakeri niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ: Kutse meta Wenikamini.
Wiriha niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ Xakeri parewiwameya: Rani meta Nepɨtahari.
Tsiripa niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ Reya parewiwameya: Kahari meta 'Atsexi. 'Ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ tɨɨri Kakuwu mɨwarayexei Parani-'Arami kwieyaritsiepai.
Kakuwu yupaapa kie kanakunuani Mamɨre, Kiriati-'Ariwa 'aurie, Hewuruni mɨrakutewatsiere, 'Apɨrahami meripaitɨ manuyeikakai meta 'Itsahaki.
'Itsahaki xeitsienituyari heimana nauka tewiyari wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni kepauka mumɨ.
Waɨkawa 'ukiratsitɨtɨ kaniɨyɨni, niwemama 'Etsahu, Kakuwu 'ukiyarimama wahamatɨa mekanikateuku.
